newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope sends condolences to S.Korea for plane crash.
newsitem.headline: Pope sends condolences to S.Korea for plane crash.

text.p: Pope John Paul sent a telegram of condolence to the archbishop of Seoul on Wednesday, expressing his sorrow for the Korean Air Lines jumbo jet crash in Guam.
Vatican Secretary of State, Cardinal Angelo Sodano, signed the telegram addressed to Archbishop Stephen Kim Sou-hwan.

"Saddened by the news of the many victims of the Korean Airlines disaster in Guam, the Holy Father wishes me to assure you that he commends the deceased to Almighty God and implores divine comfort upon the survivors," Sodano said.
"He asks you to convey to their suffering families, and to the authorities, his condolences and the assurance of his prayerful closeness," he wrote in English.
The 747 jumbo jet crashed on Tuesday on the U.S. Pacific island of Guam, killing more than 200 people. Some 30 people survived.
